changelog: Public license and health endpoints reveal operational detail only when the JWT still belongs to an active user with the current authorization version.
Sentry now correlates installations through an irreversible hash and no longer receives raw hardware IDs, customer names, host names or non-pseudonymous users.
changelog_es: Los endpoints públicos de licencia y salud solo revelan detalle cuando el JWT pertenece a un usuario existente y conserva su versión de autorización; tokens
